##: Hersir from the ready-made Windows build of one of its releases (https://github.com/Yotech-AI/hersir).
The zip is the release's own, as Release builds made it. Its sha256 is its line in the release's SHA256SUMS, which the release's signature (hersir-X.Y.Z.sig) covers.
scripts/packages.sh in Yotech-AI/hersir writes this file for each signed release, from packaging/scoop/hersir.json there: changes to it go there.
No checkver or autoupdate: only that script changes the version, and only after the release's signature checks.
description: Talk to one Chief that runs a team of AI coding agents through your board
notes: Hersir doesn't update itself when Scoop installed it: quit Hersir, then run scoop update; scoop update hersir
Your data stays in %APPDATA%\Hersir, also after scoop uninstall hersir
post_install: Write-Host 'No Start menu shortcut: only Hersir from its bucket gets one (scoop bucket add hersir https://github.com/Yotech-AI/scoop-bucket).'
